title: When Your Quiet Teen Freezes in Group Work
summary: Help a quiet teen enter group work without taking over: prepare one entry line, one visible contribution, and one recovery move.
seo_title: Quiet Teen Group Work: A Parent Plan
seo_description: Help your quiet teen enter group work without forcing confidence: prepare one entry line, visible contribution, recovery move, and a calm parent check-in.
release_move: The parent helps prepare a proportionate first move and requests structure if needed; the teenager decides whether and how to use it.

core_belief_shift.from: My quiet teen needs to become more outgoing before group work can go well.
core_belief_shift.to: My teen can enter group work with one small work-focused move, contribute something visible, and recover after an awkward start.

book_relevance.reason: The Social Playbook is an optional teen-owned fit for practising conversation, reading a group, and making a useful contribution; the parent guide remains complete without it.

next_step.label: Support quiet belonging beyond the classroom
next_step.reason: Use this next when the same quiet pattern shows up in team settings and your teen needs one low-pressure bridge into belonging.

hero.alt: A quiet teenage boy pauses beside a classroom group while his mother waits discreetly in the doorway.
